To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a Quad-cavity can provide the beam quadrupole moments and the rms-beam-size, if the beam position at the cavity is known.
a resonant cavity with a quadrupole mode can be used to monitor beam emittance.
the resonant cavity based beam monitoring system is a non-invasive approach to measure the shot-to-shot non- Gaussian beam size, shape, and emittance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a resonant cavity based beam monitoring system.
the development of a single-shot, non-invasive beam emittance measurement system.
the design, fabrication, and testing of a resonant cavity for beam emittance measurement.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Quad-cavity system is a promising approach to beam emittances measurement of a shot to shot non-circular beam.
the Quad-cavity is a promising candidate for a non-invasive beam monitoring system for a shot-to-shot beam emittance measurement.

a resonant cavity based beam monitoring system is a very promising approach to the measurement of beam size and shape, and the emittance, for both single bunches and bunch trains, in the linear and the nonlinear regime of a beam transport system, with a single shot.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have demonstrated a single-shot, non-invasive, and high resolution emittance measurement system for a multi-bunch beam. Proc. SPIE 3151, Accelerator-Based X-Ray and Particle Sources, (1 October 1997);
the Quad-cavity system can provide a single-shot measurement of the rms-beam emittance and the beam size.

the Quad-cavity is a very promising tool for single shot emittance measurement of multi-bunch beam pulses, and it is also a useful tool for the study of beam dynamics in a transport system. 11 refs., 7 figs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a resonant cavity is a very powerful tool for beam diagnostics.
a Quad-cavity can measure the emittance of a non-circular, multi-bunch beam pulse, with only one shot.
a single-shot, non-invasive, and non-circular beam monitoring system is feasible.
